subject: Operations
title: Defining Quality
description: A short lesson to help you apply Defining Quality.

hook.text: A $10 watch tells time perfectly. A $10,000 Rolex does the same. Which has higher quality? It depends who you ask.

buildup.text: Quality has many definitions: fitness for use, conformance to spec, delighting the customer, or exceeding expectations.

discovery.text: Juran said quality is fitness for use. Crosby said conformance to requirements. Both views are correct.

twist.text: A product can meet every spec and still fail—if the spec didn't match what the customer actually wanted.

climax.text: Modern quality starts with the customer's voice and works backward into design, production, and delivery.

punchline.text: Quality is what the customer says it is.
